title: On NFP, both sides sweep — and it's over before 9:30

hero.caption: of NFP days sweep **both** sides of the pre-release range. And when they do, it's usually finished before the 9:30 cash open.

chart.label: How NFP takes out the pre-release range
chart.sub: Reference range = the 08:15–08:30 ET consolidation before the print
chart.note: The whipsaw is a premarket event — by the New York open the range is usually already taken both ways.

useIt: NFP runs both directions, and the round-trip is usually finished before New York even opens. Don't chase the first 8:30 spike as direction — the other side gets taken too.
